paragraphs.text: 1. FAR is that secret name by which, in terror, the worlds invoked thee and thou gavest vigour
paragraphs.original: दूरे तन्नाम गुह्यं पराचैर्यत्त्वा भीते अह्वयेतां वयोधै ।
paragraphs.translit: dūre tannāma guhyaṃ parācairyattvā bhīte ahvayetāṃ vayodhai |

paragraphs.text: The earth and heaven thou settest near each other, and Maghavan, madest bright thy Brother's Children.
2. Great is that secret name and far-extending, whereby thou madest all that is and shall be.
paragraphs.original: महत्तन्नाम गुह्यं पुरुस्पृग्येन भूतं जनयो येन भव्यम् ।
paragraphs.translit: mahattannāma guhyaṃ puruspṛgyena bhūtaṃ janayo yena bhavyam |

paragraphs.text: The Five Tribes whom he loveth well have entered the light he loveth that was made aforetime.
paragraphs.original: प्रत्नं जातं ज्योतिर्यदस्य प्रियं प्रियाः समविशन्त पञ्च
paragraphs.translit: pratnaṃ jātaṃ jyotiryadasya priyaṃ priyāḥ samaviśanta pañca

paragraphs.text: 3. He filled the heaven and earth and all between them, Gods five times sevenfold in their proper seasons.
paragraphs.original: आ रोदसी अपृणादोत मध्यं पञ्च देवाँ ऋतुशः सप्तसप्त ।
paragraphs.translit: ā rodasī apṛṇādota madhyaṃ pañca devām̐ ṛtuśaḥ saptasapta |

paragraphs.text: With four-and-thirty lights he looks around him, lights of one colour though their ways are divers.
paragraphs.original: चतुस्त्रिंशता पुरुधा वि चष्टे सरूपेण ज्योतिषा विव्रतेन
paragraphs.translit: catustriṃśatā purudhā vi caṣṭe sarūpeṇa jyotiṣā vivratena

paragraphs.text: 4. As first among the lights, O Dawn, thou shonest, whereby thou broughtest forth the Stay of Increase,
paragraphs.original: यदुष औच्छः प्रथमा विभानामजनयो येन पुष्टस्य पुष्टम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yaduṣa aucchaḥ prathamā vibhānāmajanayo yena puṣṭasya puṣṭam |

paragraphs.text: Great art thou, matchless is thine Asura nature, who, high above, art kin to those beneath thee.
5. The old hath waked the young Moon from his slumber who runs his circling course with many round him.
paragraphs.original: विधुं दद्राणं समने बहूनां युवानं सन्तं पलितो जगार ।
paragraphs.translit: vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ samane bahūnāṃ yuvānaṃ santaṃ palito jagāra |

paragraphs.text: Behold the Gods' high wisdom in its greatness: he who died yesterday to-day is living.
paragraphs.original: देवस्य पश्य काव्यं महित्वाद्या ममार स ह्यः समान
paragraphs.translit: devasya paśya kāvyaṃ mahitvādyā mamāra sa hyaḥ samāna

paragraphs.text: 6. Strong is the Red Bird in his strength, great Hero, who from of old hath had no nest to dwell in.
paragraphs.original: शाक्मना शाको अरुणः सुपर्ण आ यो महः शूरः सनादनीळः ।
paragraphs.translit: śākmanā śāko aruṇaḥ suparṇa ā yo mahaḥ śūraḥ sanādanīḷaḥ |

paragraphs.text: That which he knows is truth and never idle: he wins and gives the wealth desired of many.
paragraphs.original: यच्चिकेत सत्यमित्तन्न मोघं वसु स्पार्हमुत जेतोत दाता
paragraphs.translit: yacciketa satyamittanna moghaṃ vasu spārhamuta jetota dātā

paragraphs.text: 7. Through these the Thunderer gained strong manly vigour, through whom he waxed in power to smite down Vrtra,-
Who through the might of Indra's operation came forth as Gods in course of Law and Order.
paragraphs.original: ये कर्मणः क्रियमाणस्य मह्न ऋतेकर्ममुदजायन्त देवाः
paragraphs.translit: ye karmaṇaḥ kriyamāṇasya mahna ṛtekarmamudajāyanta devāḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. All-strong, performing works with his companion, All-marking, rapid Victor, Curse-averter,
The Hero, waxing, after draughts of Soma, blew far from heaven the Dasyus with his weapon.
paragraphs.original: पीत्वी सोमस्य दिव आ वृधानः शूरो निर्युधाधमद्दस्यून्
paragraphs.translit: pītvī somasya diva ā vṛdhānaḥ śūro niryudhādhamaddasyūn
